subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this Z.AI endpoint-detection fix wait for redacted live Coding Plan proof, receive a maintainer proof waiver, or be superseded by a different sibling PR?
rationale: The remaining blocker is proof sufficiency and canonical PR selection, not a code repair that ClawSweeper can safely automate without maintainer-held Z.AI credentials.

options.title: Require Live Proof Or Waiver
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that proof gap while choosing one canonical PR.

options.title: Accept Source And Mock Proof
options.body: Treat the linked issue's live before-fix output plus this branch's focused source/test proof as enough for normal merge review.

options.title: Choose A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Land another narrow sibling PR for the same issue and close this PR as superseded only after that fix merges or becomes the clearly proof-positive path.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof Or Waiver
